purpose: Home companion background plates; live avatar and props overlaid separately

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background plate for a small Home virtual-pet widget in TrainerOS on a handheld. Create ONE standalone landscape image, 4:3 composition. A charming high quality stylized 3D game environment with rounded simplified forms, softly bevelled low-poly geometry, readable saturated accent colors, warm natural materials, soft contact shadows and clear depth. Camera nearly frontal, slightly elevated only about 12 degrees, shallow perspective, cozy human-scale surroundings for a small chibi humanoid avatar. Crucial functional layout: the central 55 percent of the width must remain open from 25 percent down to 86 percent of height; a broad flat unobstructed floor/ground occupies the lower 45 percent. This is where a live 3D character and interchangeable toys and furniture will be composited later. Put decorative objects at the far edges and background only. Keep center midtones quiet for legibility of a character, never washed out. Frame fills the entire image, no cutaway dollhouse base, no card border. Important: no people, no pets, no character silhouettes, no text, letters, logos, HUD, buttons, speech balloons, coins, or watermarks. No heavy blur, no tiny noisy detail. Must remain attractive and clear when reduced to 269 by 208 pixels. Scene: a cozy sunny little living room, honey-colored oak plank floor, sage green lower wall panels and warm ivory plaster. A small rounded window high on the back left sees leafy green trees and blue sky; diffuse morning light. At far left a low short bookcase with a few colorful books and a small leafy plant; far right a compact wall shelf with a ceramic pot and warm coral curtain edge. Keep furniture behind and outside the central character stage. Welcoming, playful and tidy, with balanced warm wood and leafy green accents. Empty central floor, no rug in center because a real 3D rug can be added later.
